title: Appears to be good quality but isn’t
text: Appears to be good quality but isn’t. Great looking pieces of silverware. Good weight and feel to them as well. However, after a run or two through the dishwasher they are now tarnished (almost a rusty look to them in random spots).

Created by Gourmet Settings, Strand flatware has a handsome yet simple design with versatile modern appeal. Crafted from 18/0 stainless steel for luster and tarnish-resistance, the pattern features a flared handle with an angular tip. Subtly energetic lines add distinction, preventing the design from feeling severe. The handle transitions smoothly to an elongated oval working end on the forks and spoons, while the knife sports a smartly angled blade. A gleaming mirror finish overall completes the look.

With 20 utensils in all, this Strand set includes four place settings, each with a salad fork, a dinner fork, a knife, a soupspoon, and a teaspoon. Safe in the dishwasher, the pieces maintain their bright finish without polishing and come with a 50-year warranty.
